privacy_promise: Your messages never leave your phone. 100% private & offline.
input_placeholder: Paste any suspicious SMS, WhatsApp message, or link here...
verdict_safe_sub: We did not find any known scam tricks in this message.
verdict_caution_sub: This message has some suspicious patterns. Proceed with caution.
verdict_danger_sub: This looks like bait. Do not click, pay, or reply.
history_title: Recent Checks (stored locally on this device)
ocr_notice: Screenshot OCR runs on-device. If image is blurry, please paste the text directly.
reason_apk_download: Invites downloading an Android .apk file. Legitimate banks and government departments never distribute apps through links.
reason_digital_arrest: Claims CBI/police warrant or 'digital arrest'. Law enforcement agencies never arrest or conduct court hearings over video calls or WhatsApp.
reason_electricity_threat: Threatens immediate power or utility disconnection tonight and gives a personal mobile number. Official utility boards never do this.
reason_kyc_suspension: Threatens that your bank account or SIM card will be blocked unless you verify KYC on a link. Banks never ask for online KYC via SMS links.
reason_job_scam: Offers unrealistic daily income for liking YouTube videos or doing online tasks. These are advance-fee fraud schemes.
reason_telegram_link: Redirects you into an untraceable Telegram group or channel where scammers operate.
reason_lottery: Claims you won a lottery or cash draw you never entered. Legitimate contests do not demand processing fees to release winnings.
reason_parcel_trap: Claims your parcel is held for a small fee (e.g. ₹25). This is a credit/debit card credential harvesting trap.
reason_credential_harvest: Asks for sensitive credentials such as OTP, ATM PIN, CVV, or passwords. Never disclose these.
reason_suspicious_domain: Uses a cheap or abusive domain extension (.top, .xyz, etc.) commonly used by criminal syndicates.
reason_link_shortener: Uses an obfuscated link shortener to disguise where the destination actually leads.
reason_urgency: Manufactures artificial urgency ('within 24 hours', 'immediately') to rush you into making a mistake.
reason_safe_clean: Standard transaction alert or personal message. No deceptive links or coercion patterns detected.
action_danger_1: Do not click any link and do not download any attached file.
action_danger_2: Do not call back or reply to the sender.
action_danger_3: Block this sender on your phone and WhatsApp immediately.
action_caution_1: Double-check with the official app or website directly, not through this message.
action_caution_2: Never share any OTP or personal details with anyone.
action_caution_3: If this claims to be from someone you know, call them directly on their saved phone number.
action_safe_1: Never share OTPs, PINs, or passwords with anyone, even bank callers.
action_safe_2: Verify the debited or credited amount in your official banking app if uncertain.
learn_subtitle: Learn how scammers operate so you and your family never take the bait.
help_subtitle: Did you already lose money or share an OTP? Act fast within the golden hour.
sos_helpline_desc: Toll-free 24/7 emergency hotline across India to freeze fraudulent transactions.
sos_step_1: 1. Call your bank immediately and freeze your debit/credit cards and NetBanking.
sos_step_2: 2. Dial 1930 right away to report the fraudulent transaction transaction IDs.
sos_step_3: 3. File an official complaint on https://cybercrime.gov.in.
sos_step_4: 4. Take screenshots of the SMS, WhatsApp messages, and transaction history as evidence.
